title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
subtitle: Sokka and his sister Kya - later renamed Katara, must travel the world to find masters for Aang, who is the Avatar. However, they must evade a critical foe, Prince Zuko of the Fire Nation, who wants to capture Aang.

title: The Boy in the Iceberg
subtitle: Se cuenta la leyenda del Avatar. Katara y Sokka encuentran a un niño extraño dentro de un iceberg.

title: The Avatar Returns
subtitle: Aang y Katara, sin darse cuenta, activan una trampa que lleva a la belicista Nación del Fuego a la pacífica aldea de la Tribu Agua del Sur en el Polo Sur.

title: The Southern Air Temple
subtitle: Después de su partida del Templo Aire del Sur hace 100 años, un emocionado Aang finalmente regresa a casa, pero está desilusionado por lo que encuentra allí.

title: The Warriors of Kyoshi
subtitle: The gang arrives at Kyoshi Island and are captured by some Kyoshi warriors. When Aang reveals that he is the avatar, news quickly spreads out and suddenly reaches to Prince Zuko who then goes to Kyoshi Island to capture him.

title: The King of Omashu
subtitle: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a king.

title: Imprisoned
subtitle: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find.

title: The Spirit World (Winter Solstice, Part 1)
subtitle: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

title: Avatar Roku (Winter Solstice, Part 2)
subtitle: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

title: The Waterbending Scroll
subtitle: Katara, desperate to improve her abilities and teach Aang, steals an expensive waterbending scroll from pirates, causing them to pursue the group.

title: Jet
subtitle: Aang, Katara, and Sokka have their friendship tested by a charismatic Rebel Leader who is fighting against the Fire Nation.

title: The Great Divide
subtitle: Aang is tested as the Avatar when he must help two feuding clans cross a dangerous canyon peacefully.

title: The Storm
subtitle: Aang relives the events after finding out that he is the Avatar 100 years ago and tells them to Katara, while Iroh tells the story of Zuko's scar and banishment to the crew.

title: The Blue Spirit
subtitle: When Aang is captured by the Fire Nation, his only hope is a mysterious masked figure.

title: The Fortuneteller
subtitle: The gang visits a village where a fortuneteller lives who is said to never be wrong. Aang tries to show Katara how he feels about her.

title: Bato of the Water Tribe
subtitle: Sokka and Katara meet a friend of their father who offers to take them to join the Water Tribe's navy. Aang fears his friends will choose seeing their father again over staying with him.

title: The Deserter
subtitle: When he meets an outcast from the Fire Nation, Aang is impatient to skip ahead in his training.

title: The Northern Air Temple
subtitle: Aang is upset when he finds an old Air Temple has been desecrated by an old inventor and his son.

title: The Waterbending Master
subtitle: The heroes finally arrive at the North Pole. But for Katara, the trip may have been in vain, as Master Pakku refuses to teach girls waterbending.

title: The Siege of the North, Part 1
subtitle: While Katara herself becomes a great waterbending master, Commander Zhao plans a siege on the Northern Water Tribe. Meanwhile, Sokka's on a mission to stop this siege while Aang tries to buy them some time.

title: The Siege of the North, Part 2
subtitle: Mientras la Nación del Fuego continúa su asalto a la Tribu Agua del Norte, Sokka, Katara y Yue emprenden la búsqueda de Aang, guiados por su espíritu.

title: The Avatar State
subtitle: Aang and friends arrive in the Earth Kingdom to begin his training, but a local general convinces Aang that all he needs to do is learn to control his Avatar state. Azula arrives to escort her brother and uncle back to the Fire Nation.

title: The Cave of Two Lovers
subtitle: On their way to Omashu, Team Avatar is forced to travel underground to avoid Fire Nation attacks. Iroh and Zuko adjust to life as fugitives.

title: Return to Omashu
subtitle: Finding the city of Aang's old friend, King Bumi, captured by the Fire Nation, the heroes hatch a plan to rescue Aang's earthbending teacher. Azula gathers two old friends to help her hunt the Avatar.

title: The Swamp
subtitle: Aang hears a swamp calling to him. In the swamp, Aang and the gang find out that this is not any natural swamp.

title: Avatar Day
subtitle: Sokka and Katara have to solve a centuries-old crime when Aang is imprisoned for a murder allegedly committed by one of his past incarnations.

title: The Blind Bandit
subtitle: While looking for an Earthbending teacher, Aang, and his friends discover a young blind girl with secrets of her own.

title: Zuko Alone
subtitle: As Zuko tries to make it by in exile without his uncle, he remembers how his father became Firelord and what happened to his mother.

title: The Chase
subtitle: Aang and friends are chased by a mysterious machine. Katara and Toph get into a heated argument. Aang realizes the reason why they are being followed by the crown princess and her friends is because of Appa's shedding.

title: Bitter Work
subtitle: Aang begins to learn earthbending from Toph; Uncle Iroh resumes teaching Zuko firebending to better prepare him for facing Azula, and reveals a new technique he learned from watching waterbenders.

title: The Library
subtitle: When he learns that there is a lost Library with all the knowledge in the world, Sokka convinces the others to seek it out in hopes of finding a weakness of the Fire Nation.

title: The Desert
subtitle: Lost in the desert without Appa, Team Avatar must find a way out. Iroh and Zuko make contact with a secret organization.

title: The Serpent's Pass
subtitle: After getting tickets for the ferry headed to Ba Sing Se, the gang meets an old friend. They skip the ride to help refugees get to Ba Sing Se. They must lead the refugees through the Serpent's Pass, a dangerous mountain-side path.

title: The Drill
subtitle: After arriving at the great wall of Ba Sing Se, Aang and the gang discover that the Fire Nation has constructed a drilling machine to penetrate the wall. Zuko and Iroh are having trouble hiding the fact that they are both Firebenders.

title: City of Walls and Secrets
subtitle: After getting a house to stay in, Aang and company are given a city tour. As they try to get in to tell the Earth King the news, they find that nothing is what it seems. Jet is in the city, too, and has suspicions about Iroh and Zuko.

title: The Tales of Ba Sing Se
subtitle: A series of short stories covering some of the time spent by Katara, Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko and Momo as they live in Ba Sing Se.

title: Appa's Lost Days
subtitle: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, will find out where he has gone and who he has met along the way and more importantly where he is now!

title: Lake Laogai
subtitle: The Avatar gang encounters Jet in Ba Sing Se and he helps them to discover the location of Appa. But they will end up discovering something else, a secret of the city.

title: The Earth King
subtitle: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

title: The Guru
subtitle: Aang receives guidance from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple; Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father; Princess Azula has something diabolical in store for her enemies; Uncle and Zuko run their own tea shop.

title: The Crossroads of Destiny
subtitle: The heroes work together to stop Azula's destructive plans; Zuko finds companionship in an unlikely source and learns the time has come to make an imperative choice about his future.

title: The Awakening
subtitle: Weeks after the fall of the Earth Kingdom, Aang and his friends must infiltrate the Fire Nation. Katara meets her father for the first time in years. Zuko returns home, but is uneasy with his newfound reputation.

title: The Headband
subtitle: Posing as a regular kid, Aang goes to a Fire Nation school and sees what's missing from their lives. Zuko visits his uncle in prison.

title: The Painted Lady
subtitle: When Aang and his friends come across a fishing village being poisoned by a nearby factory, a local legend comes to life to help the townspeople.

title: Sokka's Master
subtitle: After deciding he's the least valuable member of the team, Sokka seeks an apprenticeship with a sword-master. The rest of the gang tries to adjust to being without him. The imprisoned Iroh may not be as beaten as he seems.

title: The Beach
subtitle: On a forced vacation, Zuko, Azula, Ty Lee and Mai try to blend in with normal teenagers and learn about themselves and one another. Aang and company are attacked by an ominous assassin.

title: The Avatar and the Fire Lord
subtitle: Both Aang and Zuko must learn the history of how the war began. Zuko learns a secret about his great-grandfather's past.

title: The Runaway
subtitle: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

title: The Puppetmaster
subtitle: Creepy things are afoot when the gang meets a mysterious old innkeeper with a secret.

title: Nightmares and Daydreams
subtitle: As the invasion approaches, Aang has recurring nightmares about being unprepared to face the Firelord. Zuko feels the perks and pressures of being the prince again.

title: The Day of Black Sun
subtitle: Zuko makes a decision about his future. Aang reunites with many of his old friends in a full-scale invasion of the Fire Nation capitol to coincide with an eclipse which will remove the Fire Nation's powers.

title: The Day of Black Sun, Part 2: The Eclipse
subtitle: The invasion seems to be succeeding until Aang learns that their arrival was anticipated. Zuko confronts his father.

title: The Western Air Temple
subtitle: The gang hides out in the Western Air Temple. Zuko tries to convince the gang of his change in heart, but they are very hesitant. Combustion Man/Sparky-Sparky Boom Man attacks again.

title: The Firebending Masters
subtitle: Zuko has joined up with Aang's group and is now ready to teach Aang fire bending. Unfortunately, Zuko has found out that he has lost his ability and must now relearn it. Zuko and Aang travel to find the original source of fire bending.

title: The Boiling Rock: Part 1
subtitle: Sokka and Zuko head to the Fire Nation's most heavily guarded prison, the Boiling Rock, in hopes of finding and breaking out the captured invasion force.

title: The Boiling Rock, Part 2
subtitle: The escape is planned and the heroes attempt to break from the prison that very day. But problems come when Azula, Mai and Ty Lee arrive at the prison.

title: The Southern Raiders
subtitle: Trying to prove that she can trust him, Zuko helps Katara track down the man who killed her mother.

title: The Ember Island Players
subtitle: The gang, now hiding at Ember Island, watch a play about themselves and their adventures.

title: Sozin's Comet, Part 1: The Phoenix King
subtitle: Sozin's Comet is only three days away. Zuko tells the others what the Fire Lord plans on the day of the comet and the gang realizes that they must stop him before then. But Aang doubts that he can do what is expected of him.

title: Sozin's Comet, Part 2: The Old Masters
subtitle: Aang awakes on a mysterious island and confronts his past lives for advice on how to stop the Fire Lord without killing him. The rest of the group searches for Aang.

title: Sozin's Comet, Part 3: Into the Inferno
subtitle: Zuko battles his sister with Katara's help for the right to be named Fire Lord. Elsewhere, Aang meets Ozai just as the comet arrives.

title: Sozin's Comet, Part 4: Avatar Aang
subtitle: Llega el momento de la verdad para Aang. ¿Podrá derrotar a Ozai, el Rey Fénix? ¿Se verá obligado a quitar una vida humana? Todos los personajes enfrentan sus mayores desafíos.
